name: Universal PDF by UNISIM
subtitle: Fill in, sign and mark up
promotionalText: Open a PDF, fill in its form, sign it and mark it up on your phone. Nothing is uploaded unless you choose to back it up or send it to someone to sign.
description:
Universal PDF opens, fills in, signs and marks up PDFs on your phone. The work happens on the device: your document is not uploaded to be shown or edited, and there is no copy on our servers unless you press a button that says so.

FILL IN AND SIGN
• Type straight into a PDF's form fields.
• Draw your signature, or import one, and place it on the page.
• Add your name, the date or a stamp with it.
• Add "Sign here" boxes and send the document to someone else to sign (needs a Universal ID).

MARK IT UP
• Highlighter, free drawing and text.
• Ticks, crosses, lines, boxes and circles.
• Place pictures and QR codes on a page.
• Redact text so it cannot be read by people or by machines.

MORE TOOLS
• Compress one PDF or several.
• Merge PDFs into one.
• Turn PDF pages into PNG or JPG images, and images into a PDF.
• Make a scanned PDF searchable.
• Open Word (.docx) and OpenDocument (.odt) files as PDFs.
• Turn pasted Markdown into a PDF.
• Lock a PDF with a password.
• Present a document full screen.

YOUR FILES STAY YOURS
• Opening, filling in, signing and marking up happen on your phone.
• Recent files are remembered on this device only.
• No ads, no tracking, no third-party analytics.
• A Universal ID is optional. It adds online backup and send to sign, and you can delete the account from inside the app.

Universal PDF is free and open source (AGPL-3.0). The code, and a page explaining exactly what leaves your device and when, are on GitHub: github.com/universal-simulation-ltd/Universal_PDF

Built by James Markey MBE and the UNI·SIM team.
